Class RealizedGainPosition

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.realizedgain.RealizedGainPosition
public class RealizedGainPosition extends Object
One sale of the realized gain report: a sale of a security, or the close of a margin position, with the gain it realized in the security currency and in the main currency.
